زَقَّاقٌ The maker of the [kind of skin called] زِقّ. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also, as in the copies of the Moheet and the A [and in the JK], or ↓ زَقَاقٌ , like سَحَابٌ, accord. to the K, but the former is probably the right, (TA,) One who drinks water (Moheet, A, K) at the table, (Moheet, K,) while having food in his mouth. (Moheet, A, K.) [As shown in the A, it is an epithet applied to a greedy man.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
